observations: A black PlayStation 4 Slim console with two black DualShock 4 controllers and a FIFA 24 game case on top.
The console has a PS4 logo on the front.
The image has a watermark 'CHEBROS MUSICALS POSTED ON JII'.

claims.claim: Perfectly working Slim ps4 with 2 pads and fifa 24, ghost of tushima, spider man, fifa 26, ...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the console, two controllers, and a FIFA 24 game case. No evidence of Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, or FIFA 26. No visible power or connectivity indicators to confirm 'perfectly working'.

risks.risk: The console may not be working properly.
risks.proof: Photo 0 does not show any power indicator, lights, or test play. A video of the console booting or playing a game would settle this.

risks.risk: The game titles mentioned may not be included or may be counterfeit.
risks.proof: Photo 0 only shows FIFA 24. No other game cases or discs are visible. A photo of all game cases or a video of them being inserted would settle this.

proof_requests: Send a photo of the console with power on and a game running, or a video of it booting.
response.reason: The seller claims the console is 'perfectly working' and includes multiple games, but the photo only shows the console, two controllers, and one game case. Without proof of functionality and the presence of all mentioned games, the claim cannot be verified remotely.
